questions.stem_text: Explain three ways in which a person's basal metabolic rate maybe determined.

options.A: BMR can be measured by the duration and quality of sleep
options.B: BMR can be estimated by the level of physical activity in a daily routine
options.C: BMR can be determined by measuring heart rate
options.D: BMR can be determined by the amount of sweat produced during physical activity
options.E: BMR can be estimated by the frequency of urination

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - BMR can be measured by the duration and quality of sleep

Why would you not expect conjugation among a group of paramecia that had descended from a
single individual through repeated fission?

options.A: conjugation results in no genetic diversity
options.B: conjugation requires more than two organisms
options.C: all individuals are identical genetically, and conjugation could not occur
options.D: repeated fission in paramecia results in sterile offspring that cannot conjugate
options.E: the group of paramecia lacks the cellular structures necessary for conjugation

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - all individuals are identical genetically, and conjugation could not occur

questions.stem_text: Which of the following are traits that are affected by more than one gene?
Do hospitals provide lower quality care on weekends?
questions.answer_explanation: Weekend hospitalization leads to delayed provision of intensive procedures and elevated 1-year mortality for elderly AMI patients. The existence of measurable differences in treatments raises questions regarding the efficacy of a single input regulation (e.g., mandated nurse staffing ratios) in enhancing the quality of weekend care. My results suggest that targeted financial incentives might be a more cost-effective policy response than broad regulation aimed at improving quality.

questions.stem_text: Is ganglionated plexi ablation during Maze IV procedure beneficial for postoperative long-term stable sinus rhythm?
questions.answer_explanation: GP ablation did not prove to be beneficial for postoperative stable NSR. A complete left atrial lesion set and biatrial ablation are advisable for improving rhythm outcomes. Randomized controlled trials are necessary to confirm our findings.

questions.stem_text: Does pediatric housestaff experience influence tests ordered for infants in the neonatal intensive care unit?
questions.answer_explanation: Interns order significantly more arterial blood gases per infant than junior and senior residents on-call in the neonatal ICU. Additional study is required to see if the experience of housestaff is associated with a broader array of neonatal outcomes, such as morbidity and mortality.

questions.stem_text: Is ankle/arm pressure predictive for cardiovascular mortality in older patients living in nursing homes?
questions.answer_explanation: The prevalence of PAD is high in nursing home residents. AAI is not predictive for IHD mortality in this population. In very frail elderly traditional risk factors and PAD are less important predictors of death compared to poor functional status, nutritional factors and previous cardiovascular disease.

questions.stem_text: Endovenous laser ablation in the treatment of small saphenous varicose veins: does site of access influence early outcomes?
questions.answer_explanation: The site of access in our study does not appear to influence complications specifically neural injury or recurrence rates.
